title: The Cup and the Prayer
summary: They take the cup and say a prayer asking God to bless and sanctify the wine for those who drink it in remembrance of Jesus Christ.

explicit_facts.text: They took the cup and said the prayer.
The prayer asks God to bless and sanctify the wine to the souls of all who drink it.
The prayer says the wine is drunk in remembrance of the blood of God's Son, shed for them.
The prayer asks that they always remember him and have his Spirit with them.

reasonable_visual_inferences: The administering group is visible holding a cup as the prayer is spoken.
unspecified_visual_details: The group's identities and number, their appearance, the cup's design, and the setting are unspecified.

spoken_dialogue.text: O God, the Eternal Father, we ask thee, in the name of thy Son, Jesus Christ, to bless and sanctify this wine to the souls of all those who drink of it,
spoken_dialogue.speaker: The administering group

narration.text: The manner of administering the wine—

doctrinal_or_story_notes: The prayer is the prescribed manner of administering the wine.
prohibited_inventions: Do not depict Jesus Christ or a visible shedding of blood; these are referenced in the prayer, not narrated as visible events.
